results.content: In the August 21-24 Economist/YouGov poll, 34 percent of college graduates approved of Trump’s job performance and 63 percent disapproved. [...] Trump’s approval among college graduates fell from 34 percent in an Economist/YouGov poll conducted August 21-24 to 31 percent in its August 28-31 survey. It dropped again to 30 percent in the poll conducted September 4-8. Over the same period, disapproval rose from 63 percent to 69 percent, widening Trump’s net deficit with the group from 29 points to 39 points.
